integrity: The proof is self-contained. Finite symbolic checks are supplementary and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved in the algebraically closed characteristic-zero setting of the motivating conjecture. It gives the exact one-variable boundary but does not extend the false general conjecture to two or more noncommuting variables. Literature search cannot certify absence from every source.
title: The one-variable rank Nullstellensatz has sharp coefficient \(\ell\)
